area: Builders: Fix selected, wider (ops_list_fix.py, bulk_test.fix_handoff and prove, the Bulk changes page and static/ops_list_fix.js)
title: Test a list rows that missed their expected outcome fixed as previewable Bulk changes operations: IP destination groups, Cloud Firewall and DNS Control rules, the ATP security policy lists, with Prove it; the group and list changes also as operations of their own

checks.what: Payload oracle per object type: IP destination group create and update, Cloud Firewall and DNS Control rule create and update, security policy denylist (ADD_TO_LIST / REMOVE_FROM_LIST) and allowlist (whole list): the SDK 1.11.3 method and only fields of its model; end to end on the sample tenant through the SDK's own services (wire fields destIpGroups, addresses, blacklistUrls, whitelistUrls)
New rules arrive DISABLED unless the operator ticks them on; enabled, a rule change, an ATP list change or a group an enabled rule uses asks for the typed phrase whatever the count

Limits: 8,000 entries per group (assumed): an existing group refuses the rest with the reason, a new group is split into numbered groups each added to the rule; 16,000 IP entries per organisation warned; IPv6 refused (no user-defined IPv6 destination group in the API); rule names at most 31 characters
Conflict guard: a group, rule or list changed after the preview is left as it is (item conflict), a tenant that moved before apply writes nothing (plan_changed)

Undo restores the tenant exactly for mixed fixes (new and existing groups, an existing rule with a service, a new rule, both ATP lists), rules before the groups they use, and keeps a created group someone changed
Scope: a fix or its Undo naming an area not ticked on the Scope page is refused before any read; the hand-off leaves out parts not in scope and is a 400 when nothing is

Mixed rows: URL, Cloud Firewall, DNS, ATP, ZPA and already-as-expected rows each go to the operation that fixes them or are excluded with the reason; Prove it re-runs exactly those rows read-only and compares them row by row
Every new control on Bulk changes has a help entry and a ? mark (or a recorded reason), the new operations carry the * mark

findings.title: Fix selected wrote only URL category changes: Cloud Firewall, DNS Control and ATP rows ended in lists to paste by hand, with no preview, conflict guard or Undo
findings.fix: ops_list_fix.py (list_fix, ip_group_edit, atp_list_edit on the Bulk changes engine), pack_ops security_denylist / security_allowlist kinds, bulk_test.fix_handoff sections and prove, /api/bulk-test/fix/{id}/prove/start, static/ops_list_fix.js

findings.title: The security policy list write methods (add_urls_to_blacklist, replace_whitelist, ...) were not on the shared-path guard's list, so a module could have called them outside pack_ops unnoticed
findings.fix: tests/test_shared_path.py WRITE_CALL names them; pack_ops is the only caller

findings.title: The new-marks browser test was tied to the 2026-10-28 marks (#tab-list, #paProto), so any newer release broke its whole fixture
findings.fix: tests/test_new_marks.py: the item-with-both probe is added for the newest release, the rotation uses a release after the newest, the 320px check expects a mark only on pages that have one, and the settle check uses Advanced settings (a page that still has marks)

findings.title: The sample tenant answered NOT_MODELLED to the security policy list writes, so the ATP part of a fix could not be tried on it
findings.fix: offline_tenant.answer_write models ADD_TO_LIST / REMOVE_FROM_LIST on /security/advanced/blacklistUrls and PUT /security
